bounty.title: A break-it bounty, paid in USDC
bounty.text: A team funds a bounty pool in BrainVault. Anyone whose injection gets past the checks, and is later revoked by the owner, is paid from the pool after a human approves with World ID. Every miss becomes a new check.
bounty.proofLabel: Payouts already work: a real 5 USDC payment, approved by a human
